offering_description.value: Doximity runs an online professional network for physicians and other clinicians. It sells targeted marketing programs to pharmaceutical companies and health systems, along with recruiting tools for healthcare employers and staffing firms. Its web and mobile apps also offer telehealth, secure communication, and AI tools for clinical documentation and reference.

primary_products.value: Professional networking platform; healthcare marketing tools; recruiting software; telehealth and secure communication software; AI clinical documentation and reference tools

primary_services.value: Targeted healthcare marketing campaigns; clinician recruitment

customer_segment.value: B2B: Pharmaceutical companies, health systems, medical practices, and healthcare recruiting firms; B2C: Individual clinicians who buy premium telehealth features

revenue_model.value: advertising: Sponsored content and targeted campaigns that reach healthcare professionals; subscription: Recurring access to marketing programs, recruiting tools, and premium telehealth features

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Uses clinician profiles and engagement data to connect clinicians with peers, advertisers, and employers; service provider: Uses client materials and audience criteria to run campaigns for pharmaceutical companies and health systems

geography_served.value: US national: Clinicians, healthcare organizations, and advertisers across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: Clinician networking, healthcare marketing, recruiting, telehealth, and AI clinical workflow tools

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise sales teams serving pharmaceutical companies, health systems, and recruiting firms; online: Doximity website and mobile apps for clinician registration and access to tools

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: HIPAA applies to covered patient communications and clinical workflows, and pharmaceutical promotions are subject to FDA rules

notes: The current scope of its staffing services is uncertain.
